tasks.description: Design and implement a passwordless authentication system using magic email links. This system should send a one-time login link to the user's email address. The link should sign the user in when clicked.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email address, when the user requests a login link, then a one-time login link is sent to the user's email address.
Given a valid one-time login link, when the user clicks the link, then the user is signed in.

tasks.description: Design and implement an email template for the one-time login link. The template should include a clear call-to-action and the login link.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email address, when the user requests a login link, then an email with a clear call-to-action and the login link is sent to the user's email address.

tasks.description: Implement session token expiration after a period of inactivity. The expiration time should be configurable.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user session, when the user is inactive for the expiration time, then the session token expires.

tasks.description: Implement accessibility features for the login flow, including screen reader support and high contrast mode.
acceptance_criteria: Given a screen reader, when the user navigates the login flow, then the screen reader announces the login fields and buttons.
Given a high contrast mode, when the user enables high contrast mode, then the login flow is displayed in high contrast.

tasks.description: Implement a mobile-friendly design for the login flow, including responsive layout and touch-friendly buttons.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mobile device, when the user navigates the login flow, then the login flow is displayed in a responsive layout.
Given a mobile device, when the user interacts with the login flow, then the buttons and fields are touch-friendly.

tasks.description: Implement localization for the login flow, including support for multiple languages and regions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a language selection, when the user selects a language, then the login flow is displayed in the selected language.
Given a region selection, when the user selects a region, then the login flow is displayed in the selected region's format.

tasks.description: Implement a feature flag to control the rollout of the new login flow. The feature flag should allow for gradual rollout to a percentage of users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a feature flag, when the feature flag is enabled, then the new login flow is displayed to the specified percentage of users.

tasks.description: Implement metrics collection for the login flow, including login success rate and time-to-login.
acceptance_criteria: Given a login attempt, when the user logs in, then the login success rate and time-to-login are recorded.
Given a metrics dashboard, when the user views the metrics dashboard, then the login success rate and time-to-login are displayed.

tasks.description: Remove the password field from the login flow, as the new authentication system is passwordless.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login flow, when the user views the login flow, then the password field is not displayed.

tasks.description: Remove the password reset feature, as the new authentication system is passwordless and does not require password reset.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login flow, when the user views the login flow, then the password reset link is not displayed.

tasks.description: Remove the password policy, as the new authentication system is passwordless and does not require a password policy.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login flow, when the user views the login flow, then the password policy is not displayed.
